title: MA52001: Multivariate Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: MA22005/MA20002/MA20102Course ContentsMultivariate normal
distribution -properties, estimation of parameters, Wishart and Hotelling s T2
distributions and their applications in testing of hypotheses problems.
Classification of observations, Mahalanobis D2 and Fisher s discriminant
function. Clustering. Principal component analysis. Canonical correlations and
canonical variables. Factor analysis.
